title: agent.run marks a run failed when its answer merely opens with the words API Error, and a run with no closing text as ok
goal: ql_capture records an agent.run exit only from a signal Claude Code documents for a failed subagent run, so an answer that opens with 'API Error handling' is not a failed run, and a run with no closing text leaves exit unset rather than 0

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture;t='API Error handling in coord.py is fixed.';f=t.startswith(ql_capture.AGENT_FAILED_TEXT);print('plain answer read as failed:',f);sys.exit(1 if f else 0)

repro_reason: the agent.run path needs a live subagent stop event to run; the repro applies the module's own failed-text test to a planted answer

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;r=q.agent_row({'hook_event_name':'SubagentStop','agent_id':'a1','agent_type':'x'},'sid1');print('exit of a stop row with no closing text:',r.get('exit'));sys.exit(1 if r.get('exit')==0 else 0)

clauses.clause: ql_capture records an agent.run exit only from a signal Claude Code documents for a failed subagent run, so an answer that opens with 'API Error handling' is not a failed run
a run with no closing text leaves exit unset rather than 0
